purpose: Current remediation evidence and complete gap matrices; this checked-in snapshot never qualifies a runtime

historical_preflight.purpose: Blocked Phase 2.0 preflight; this snapshot cannot qualify a release or operation

actual_initial_baseline.method: Independent in-memory Git object/YAML/JSON/reference/embedded-schema/generator-AST discovery; no modified repository validator imports

audit_findings.root_cause: Published migration v1.6 rejects real route expiry, API compatibility and readiness fields.
audit_findings.resolution: Intentional major v2 release preserves richer producer output; consumer/generator/source/copy migration; old release removed.

audit_findings.root_cause: Boolean schema versions and ignored unknown/missing scope, platform and attribute entries.
audit_findings.resolution: Require exact non-boolean version, declared platforms/IDs and all source/target/owner sets.
evidence: 15 real protected-file controls; original loader fails 6

audit_findings.root_cause: Missing-token authentication receipts could satisfy effective authorization.
audit_findings.resolution: Separate authentication; current-authority denials require authenticated principal and no unauthorized effects.
evidence: tests/contracts/test_assurance.py; original forged receipt negative control fails

audit_findings.boundary: Five Python and four Laravel components
audit_findings.root_cause: Formatting/import/type defects fail required source quality.
audit_findings.resolution: Format and correctly type existing implementation; pin Lifecycle development stubs; preserve assertions and controls.

audit_findings.root_cause: Existing actual PostgreSQL/TLS broker/browser suite was omitted from required PR outcome.
audit_findings.resolution: Reuse existing integration suite, require its result and separate reusable concurrency by suite.

audit_findings.root_cause: Two backslashes form invalid psql command.
evidence: CI 38642332673 P03-P06 invalid command; later real bootstrap succeeds

audit_findings.root_cause: Unconditional delegation ledger table/index creation fails provisioning replay.
audit_findings.resolution: IF NOT EXISTS preserves rows and reapplies owner privileges.
evidence: CI 38644129101 existing-table failure; CI 38644920007 P02 all three browsers pass

audit_findings.root_cause: Harness opens a safely retired producer-local OpenAPI copy.
audit_findings.resolution: Remove obsolete copy assertion; retain actual PostgreSQL producer/canonical response checks.
evidence: CI 38642332673 missing file; later P02 passes

audit_findings.root_cause: Old error envelope was expected to pass v2 installed validation.
audit_findings.resolution: Positive exact Error v2 denial; original old envelope explicitly rejected.

audit_findings.root_cause: UUID keys violate unchanged Governance v2 lowercase-hex bounds.
audit_findings.resolution: Use fresh cryptographic hex keys; real runtime adapters already conform.
evidence: CI 38644129101 422; subsequent journeys reach actual operations

audit_findings.root_cause: Witness pattern rejects legitimate GET / version-discovery path.
audit_findings.resolution: Allow valid root under existing 404-character/GET/no-CRLF limits; real PostgreSQL mutation controls.

audit_findings.root_cause: Expired/unbounded API case survives a future aggregate expiry with correct receipt digest.
audit_findings.resolution: Require current integer nested expiry and bound aggregate lifetime.
evidence: Original runtime accepts expired case; deliberate restoration: 4 failed/1 passed; corrected: 5 passed

audit_findings.root_cause: Stale fixtures omit current readiness/Catalogue checks; route-only evidence assumes commissioned workload admission.
audit_findings.resolution: Reuse current explicitly synthetic specimen; require actual uncommissioned denial and current resolver checks.
evidence: 30 composition/90 denial controls; 270 directional scenarios, 3348 boundaries, 1800 rejections; E2 only

audit_findings.root_cause: Old policy fixture lacks network_flow_contexts and current reviewed recovery fields; eligibility still differs after correction.
audit_findings.resolution: Current contexts/recovery specimen added; investigate remaining eligibility mismatch.
evidence: CI 38644920007 KeyError; CI 38647622315 eligibility assertion fails

audit_findings.root_cause: Actual federated identity returned from /identity/session is rejected by the published bootstrap-only CurrentIdentity schema.
audit_findings.resolution: Intentional major release and exact installed consumer remediation required; producer must retain legitimate federated behavior.
evidence: CI 38647622315, artifact 11933750228; observed response_valid=false after real recovery sign-in

audit_findings.root_cause: Transient GitHub archive HTTP 500 and official pinned APK 404 prevent image acquisition.
audit_findings.resolution: Bounded three-attempt network recognition; retain exact byte/digest/signature requirements.
evidence: Independent zlib 200/56195 bytes/exact locked digest; all nine subsequent images pass

audit_findings.root_cause: Minimum gate reports 0/166 qualified HTTP operations and 71/75 unqualified releases; full criterion evidence absent.
audit_findings.resolution: Actual live traffic recording extends existing probe; complete remaining authentic security/consumer/event evidence.
evidence: Minimum report 1073 required claims/358 verified; cannot substitute for full feature acceptance

external_requirements: Planning's independently provisioned PLANNING_MIGRATION_COLLECTION_REGISTRY_FILE and referenced manifest bytes are unavailable; their canonical release identity cannot be verified from this checkout.

installed_usage.description: Production loader, package inclusion and generator evidence for every active installed JSON copy. This is not authorization to delete canonical releases.
